data.body: **[P2] Do not let an End-hook error replace continuation-fatal retry control.** A checkpoint-continuation fatal is represented by a retryable `UnrecoverableDurableExecutionException` carrying the original JVM fatal. If an invocation-end hook throws `AssertionError` or another unisolated `Error`, this call exits before the control exception is rethrown, so the caller loses the promised retry type and fatal cause. Combine these failures using fatal precedence and test continuation fatal plus a failing End hook.
